questions.help: Used to link to your city guide.

options.label: Electric heat (baseboards, furnace or heat pump)

programs.name: PSE heat pump (electric heat to heat pump)
programs.rules: For electric resistance heat. $2,400 for income-qualified households. PSE contractor required.

programs.name: PSE hybrid heat pump (with a gas furnace)
programs.rules: For homes with a PSE natural gas furnace. Ducted heat pump only. $2,400 for income-qualified households.

programs.name: PSE heat pump water heater
programs.rules: Tier 3 or Tier 4 model installed on or after January 1, 2026. Apply within 30 days. $1,100 for income-qualified households.

programs.name: PSE insulation and air sealing

amount.label: Up to $5,000 per wall or floor area

programs.rules: Attic $1.75 per sq ft up to $3,500; walls and floors $2.50 per sq ft up to $5,000 each. PSE contractor takes it off the invoice.

programs.name: PSE windows
programs.rules: $200 per window for income-qualified households. Buy and install by December 31, 2026.

programs.name: PSE smart thermostat
programs.rules: $175 or $130 for income-qualified households. Buy and install by December 31, 2026.

programs.name: PSE EV home charger
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR smart Level 2 charger. Up to $600 plus $2,000 for installation if income-qualified.

programs.name: PSE Flex Batteries
programs.rules: Enrollment incentive depends on battery size and taking part in Flex events.

programs.name: Seattle City Light heat pump contractor discount
programs.rules: Through a participating contractor and supplier. By efficiency rating. No do-it-yourself installs.

programs.name: Seattle oil-to-electric rebate
programs.rules: For Seattle homes heating with oil that switch to a qualified heat pump through a participating contractor. We have not confirmed it adds to the contractor discount, so only the larger counts.

programs.name: Seattle City Light heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR Tier 3 or Tier 4. Contractor, store coupon or online rebate; the coupon and the online rebate cannot be combined.

programs.name: Seattle City Light smart thermostat
programs.rules: Instant discount on Mysa and Sinope thermostats bought from the maker's City Light page.

programs.name: Avista heat pump contractor discount
programs.rules: Per outdoor system, by efficiency rating. Goes to your contractor, who may pass it on.

programs.name: Avista heat pump water heater discount
programs.rules: Retrofit unit under 120 gallons, rating of 2.1 or higher. Contractor discount.

programs.name: Avista Home Insulation Program
programs.rules: Attics, floors and walls that start thin. Free assessment from an approved installer. No income test.

programs.name: Avista windows and sliding glass doors
programs.rules: $180 or $225 per window with a contractor, by U-factor. Apply within 120 days.

programs.name: Tacoma Power heat pump
programs.rules: $2,000 for a variable-speed heat pump replacing an electric forced-air furnace; $1,000 in several other cases. Participating contractor required.

programs.name: Tacoma Power electric hybrid water heater
programs.rules: Replacing a standard electric tank with a Tier 3 or Tier 4 model.

programs.name: Tacoma Power insulation
programs.rules: $750 each for the attic, walls and crawlspace. Electric main heat and thin starting insulation.

programs.name: Tacoma Power windows
programs.rules: Replacing single-pane or double-pane metal-framed windows. Participating contractor.

programs.name: Tacoma Power smart thermostat
programs.rules: Electric forced-air furnace or central heat pump. Up to two rebates.

programs.name: Tacoma Power EV charging credits
programs.rules: $400 credits for a charger, splitter, electrical work or outlet, $600 maximum.

programs.name: Clark Public Utilities heat pump
programs.rules: Electrically heated home. Contractor Network installer required.

programs.name: Clark Public Utilities heat pump water heater
programs.rules: Tier 3 or Tier 4, replacing an electric storage water heater. An Oregon store markdown cancels the rebate.

programs.name: Clark Public Utilities insulation
programs.rules: Electrically heated homes with thin insulation.

programs.name: Clark Public Utilities windows
programs.rules: By window rating and old frame type. Electrically heated homes.

programs.name: Clark Public Utilities smart thermostat
programs.rules: Instant rebate at the utility's online marketplace for an electric furnace or heat pump.

notes: Solar: Washington exempts solar equipment and installation from sales tax through 2029, but there is no verified upfront rebate, so solar is not in this calculator.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Income-qualified households may get more from PSE's Efficiency Boost or from local partners of the state program.
